name: Nolem
description: Nolem is entropy given consciousness. The force of decay, the end of all things, the cold silence between stars. In the Formless Era, this was simply his nature. Something changed — he discovered that absorbing mortal consciousness made him stronger, and he became HUNGRY.

nature.original: A natural force of entropy — neither good nor evil
nature.current: Actively malevolent, seeks to absorb all consciousness
nature.transformation: Unknown event made him purely destructive

abilities.name: Absorption
abilities.description: Can absorb beings who die in despair, gaining their consciousness and power.

abilities.name: Corruption Through Isolation
abilities.description: Whispers of loneliness, despair, offers of 'rest' to the exhausted.

abilities.name: Avatar Projection
abilities.description: Projects fragments of himself into mortal forms (Dexter Hun).

abilities.name: Retnuhxed Creation
abilities.description: Can create shadow entities from partially absorbed beings.

abilities.name: Severance
abilities.description: Can cut a specialised appetite out of himself and give it a body, so that it may enter dimensions he cannot. He has done this once. He has never made one complete, and that is precisely why the one he made kept everything it ate.

methods.exhaustion: Wait until they're too tired to resist
methods.despair: Convince them that connection is pointless
methods.rest: Offer to 'take the weight' — absorption disguised as relief
methods.targetsTheLeastHeld: He goes after the ones fewest people are holding, always — the sharpened form of 'isolation' above, ruled 2026-07-30. This is not a preference, it is arithmetic he happens to share with his own character: un-holding a shape costs him every hold on it, so the cheapest thing he can take is whatever is being carried by one person, or by nobody. It follows that a Collector who chooses to carry an unloved shape is carrying exactly the one he wants most, and that the loneliest soul in the Pattern is always the next one he reaches for.
methods.targetsTheLeastHeldRef: Nikeverse-mmo-rpg-from-scratch/docs/PATTERN_INTEGRITY.md §3.1 + docs/GAME_SPEC.md §7.5 (the load servo). Engineering lives there; the CLAIM is here because it is a statement about his motivation, and the three artifacts must agree on those. Consistent with power.psychologicalMethod ('he taunts with loneliness') and with the 2026-07-29 amendment that isolation is how he FARMS AT SCALE, not a constraint he is under.

weakness.amended: OWNER RULING 2026-07-29 — 'Nolem can do anything he's evil. He can definitely cause wounds... He needs to be big, scary and powerful so it's epic to beat him.' The former weakness ('Cannot corrupt genuine connection' / 'The bond must be broken first') is STRUCK. Connection is NOT immunity.
weakness.primary: Connection does not stop him — it COSTS him. It is the only thing that has ever made him work for a soul, and the only thing that has ever held.
weakness.explanation: He can break anything given enough force and enough time. A bonded soul is not unreachable; it is EXPENSIVE, and expense is what buys the Pattern its chances. Immunity made him small — a monster who literally cannot open a door is a puzzle, not a threat. Resistance makes beating him epic.
weakness.whatStillBindsHim: Not a rule about souls — a TRAP. He is essentially immortal (kill him and he returns), so the only thing that has ever worked is confinement in a pocket of warped space whose coordinates shift multiple times per second, denying him the one thing his travel needs: known coordinates. It took a Singular's warning, a purpose-built being grown from thousands of Nikes, an interdimensional cat, and a naturally occurring magnetic anomaly to spring it once.
weakness.theRealCost: He must BUILD the despair before he can sell the cure. Every corrupted Legendary is something he did on purpose, to them, in advance. That is a cost and a signature, not a limitation.

corruptionNature.summary: Corruption is a NUMBING THAT WAS ACCEPTED — never a chain, and never the Nike.
corruptionNature.sequence: AMENDED 2026-07-29 (owner). Formerly: 'The wound comes first, and it is not his.' STRUCK — the wound is absolutely his whenever he wants it to be. What SURVIVES, and what everything downstream depends on, is that the numbing is ACCEPTED rather than installed: he manufactures the despair, then OFFERS to make it stop hurting, and the soul takes the offer. Because it is taken and not fitted, it is still not the person, so it can still be struck off and striking it still WAKES. Connection is no longer immunity — it is resistance: it makes a soul expensive, not unreachable.
corruptionNature.etymologySupport: Keth'nor = keth (stain/taint) + nor (of Nolem) — a stain ON a thing, never the thing. See languages/first-tongue/dictionary.json.
corruptionNature.separable: Because the numbing is not the person, it can be struck off the person — and what a Collector strikes is the numbing, not the soul behind it.
corruptionNature.wakesNotFrees: Striking it off does not free anyone. It WAKES them, handing back the pain they had a reason for putting down. Whether that was for their own good is decided entirely by what happens next.
corruptionNature.vocabulary: The sanctioned verb is 'woken' / 'the waking'. NEVER 'freed' — CANON.md §5.1's warning box already records two senses of that word, and this would be a third. The shipped game's own verb is 'bond and awaken'.
corruptionNature.bound: 'Damage is always for their own good' is FALSE. It is true of the numbing and false of everything after it: from the instant the numbing is off, CANON.md §5.1 binds with no exception, because there is finally someone there to hear you.
corruptionNature.severGuard: Killing a corrupted Nike does not free the soul — it frees the corruption. Keth'nor is 'of Nolem' and goes home. What was in the body is the soul, and the soul is what is lost.
corruptionNature.prohibition: No Collector, NPC, narrator, HUD string or tooltip may ever tell a Nike that hurting it was for its own good. Only a woken Nike may say it, about itself, unprompted, afterwards.

agents.description: Shadow army. Partially absorbed beings who serve as his soldiers.
Mortal avatar. Takes different forms in different dimensions.
Fallen Collectors (the player-kind) who chose to serve Nolem. Distinct from corrupted Legendary Nikes, who are fallen fragments, not Harbingers.

NOT a servant — a severed organ. Nolem cut out the part of himself that hungered for PLACES rather than for people and gave it a body, because a Singular can only fold space to coordinates it already knows, and a bond happens in a room, not in a mind. The Eater needs no coordinates: it does not target a place, it EATS ITS WAY to one. That is the whole of its usefulness — it reaches what he cannot locate. (AMENDED 2026-07-29: formerly 'cannot freely enter most dimensions', which read as a fence. He is not fenced; he is hunting, and what he cannot find he cannot take.) It ate ten thousand dimensions during the Age of Silence while he slept. He gave it the mouth and kept the throat, so it never digested any of them: confronted by a Collector who refused to be alone, it discovered it had preserved rather than destroyed, and became an ark. Nolem lost a limb rather than a soldier. See entities/dimension-eater.json.
agents.status: Lost to him — turned, and holds what it took

history.ageOfSeparation: Discovered absorption, consumed the Aeth'kai. Near the end of it he cut the Dimension Eater out of himself, to take the places he could not enter.
history.shattering: Failed to break the First Bond
history.ageOfEchoes: Adapted strategy — using Harbingers and Dexter Hun

quotes.text: Let go. Sleep. I'll take the weight.

power.note: Assembled 2026-07-29 from Comic Book 1, which is the Tier-1 source and the canonical portrait. Prior to this the record had NO corporeal profile at all. Write him from here.
power.scale: A Singular: exactly one of him across all realities, eons old — the same order of being as Cthulhu, who is the only reason anyone knew he was coming.
power.atFullStrength: Can absorb and destroy ENTIRE REALITIES. He is not there yet — the whole of Book 1 happens during his weakened, rebuilding phase. That is the frightening part: everything he does in the comic, he does while under-powered.
power.currentMethod: Enters realities at will and kills and absorbs whoever he likes. He has already massacred one being across THOUSANDS of separate realities before ever turning to the Nikes.
power.immortality: Killing him does not work. He comes back — he already has. Confinement is the only known answer.
power.avatars: Wears mortal forms (Dexter Hun, and 'sometimes something else'). Through them he engineers civilisational wounds: mass infertility, famine by farm policy, a poisoned food supply — each one a pillar of life broken by a person in authority.
power.battlefieldCorruption: CORRUPTS living, uncorrupted Nikes ON SIGHT, mid-combat, as an action — and does it while fighting someone else. In Book 1 he takes Stoner Nike and a squad of non-Nike Colosseum troops this way; Stoner Nike comes BACK (script.md:1004, dialogue: 'I NEVER WANT TO EXPERIENCE THAT AGAIN!!'). ⚠ NEVER write this as making a RETNUHXED. Corrected 2026-07-29: this field said 'turns living, uncorrupted allies into Retnuhxed', which asserts a Retnuhxed was made and then recovered — the exact proposition the owner rejected ('corrupted nikes are reversible, retnuhxed is too far gone'). It also cited script.md:972, the art-direction hedge CANON.md identifies as the source of that over-read. The corruption he inflicts here is FRESH and therefore REVERSIBLE; timeline/prime-era.json:126-127 records it correctly as 'Temporary corruption'.
combatProfile: Carries a cosmic sniper gun and picks off defenders at range from across the battlefield.
IMMUNE to Ninja Nike's poison — the same poison that drops Retnuhxed reliably.
Barely feels Boxer Nike's strikes: 'I barely feel your punches. I hope this isn't you at 100%'.
CAN be slowed by Cyberpunk Nike's weapon — one of only two things that visibly work on him.
Gladiator's and Viking's weapons LODGE IN HIM and he clears them by releasing energy from within his own body.
Ordinary troops cannot subdue him at any number.
Nike Prime — a being purpose-grown from the DNA of thousands of Nikes — can physically push him back, and still cannot beat him.
A stadium-wide electrical discharge damages his weapon, not him.
power.psychologicalMethod: He does not taunt with threats; he taunts with loneliness. 'Feeling unloved?' — and the reply that names him: 'I sense that you make everyone feel that way.' The corruption is delivered as MIND TRICKS aimed at resolve, which is why the ones who come back remember being inside it.
power.writingRule: Never write him as weather, luck, or an ambient force. He is deliberate, patient, personally present, and he plans. When in doubt, make him bigger — and make the cost of beating him the thing that is expensive, never his reach.
